connector.name: Trident
connector.registryDescription: Create and edit collaborative architecture diagrams with any AI assistant using the Trident 2D DSL.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.tridentchart.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package trident-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the alexeibespalov account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
